messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis  
Details:  
The failing test `testCpioUnarchiveCreatedByRedlineRpm` reads a CPIO archive created by Redline RPM and encounters an `IllegalArgumentException` due to a non-zero file mode on the trailer entry. The bug report explicitly says that Redline RPM creates CPIO archives with a non-zero file mode on the trailer, causing this failure.

Looking at the `getNextCPIOEntry()` method in `CpioArchiveInputStream`, the method reads the header and identifies the format type of the entry, then calls `readNewEntry()` for new format entries. It returns a `CpioArchiveEntry` object after reading.

The `readNewEntry()` method builds the `CpioArchiveEntry`, reading fields including mode. Importantly, it calls `setMode(mode)` only if the mode is non-zero. Then if the mode is zero but the entry name is not `CPIO_TRAILER`, it throws an IOException, enforcing that only the trailer can have mode 0.

The critical part is the `setMode(long mode)` method in `CpioArchiveEntry`. It extracts the file type bits (`mode & S_IFMT`) and validates that they are among known types (directory, link, regular file, fifo, char, block, socket, whiteout). If they are not one of these known mode bits, it throws an `IllegalArgumentException` with a message "Unknown mode."

The Redline RPM archive apparently produces a trailer entry with a mode that is non-zero but includes bits that do not match any known file type. When `setMode` is called with that mode, it throws the `IllegalArgumentException`. Because the trailer entry should be allowed to have zero mode, Redline RPM deviation with a non-zero mode breaks the invariant `setMode` expects.

In summary, the bug is caused by the combination of:
- `readNewEntry()` allowing non-zero mode on the trailer entry,
- `setMode()` enforcing a strict known mode mask on the mode bits,
- Redline RPM archive producing a trailer with non-zero mode bits outside the expected mask,
- causing `setMode()` to throw an `IllegalArgumentException` when reading the trailer entry.

The root cause is that the trailer entry mode from Redline RPM is outside the accepted modes and should be tolerated as a special case or masked/ignored.

Recent bug reports are unrelated (zip64 issues or other archive formats) and do not mention this CPIO mode validation issue.

This explains why attempting to read the Redline RPM CPIO archive fails with an `IllegalArgumentException` when reaching the trailer entry mode check in `setMode()`.

---

Next, we should consider fixing the mode validation in `setMode(long)` to tolerate this Redline RPM trailer mode or add a special case to allow non-zero trailer modes that do not match known file type bits.
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.cpio.CpioArchiveEntry.setMode(long)  
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.cpio.CpioArchiveInputStream.readNewEntry(boolean)
